comments.text: This is the absolute best documentary about India I've ever seen!  The way the information is presented with the numbers helps summarize each topic & keeps the facts in the forefront.  I learned more that I had to post a second time.  Again THANK YOU!!

comments.author: @CathyCrawford-l7w
comments.text:
🇮🇳 India is a fascinating country & a sorrowful one.  I've been intrigued by it for years & years.  My best friend is married to an Indian.    He came to study medicine.  He's a family physician for 35 years & I've been one for about that long.  I try to learn as much as I can.  Thanks for taking me on your journey there.
Grover, North Carolina USA
